defects.problem: Dissolve from the stats card into the redacted screen leaves ghosted, double-struck text: stat rows overlap the form at 0.05s, and at 2.05s 'Billing address', 'Update payment method' and field labels look doubled or smeared. Reads as a soft, unclean transition.
defects.fix: Shorten the cross-dissolve or hold the incoming screen on a clean frame before the headline appears; do not overlap two text layers at readable opacity.

defects.problem: Dimmed screen with the 'Cancel subscription' highlight and step badge is tiny (about 60px wide) and low-contrast against the dark overlay. The highlighted control is hard to read, and the cursor sits far from it, so the step proof is weak.
defects.fix: Lift the overlay dim, or crop the highlight into the right-hand column at the same scale. No zoom needed.

defects.problem: About 9 seconds on one static screen. Left column shows a mostly empty lower third, with the caption and a grey footnote floating far below the screenshot. Right column text stacks with uneven gaps. The ending feels like a template slide, not a composed end card.
defects.fix: Tighten the vertical rhythm: bring the caption and footnote up under the screenshot and align the right block to the screenshot's vertical centre. Merge the small footers into one line.

defects.problem: Caption repeats the headline word for word ('Review on your device.' and 'Send one clear step.' appear twice on screen). The caption is redundant clutter.
defects.fix: Drop the bottom caption on these beats and keep the burned subtitle only.

defects.problem: URL line 'github.com/jeevesh2515/showme' ends about 55px from the right edge, tighter than the 48px left margin suggests. The 'Built solo...' paragraph and 'AI-generated narration.' are small, mid-grey and low-weight.
defects.fix: Reduce the URL size slightly or widen the right gutter. Raise footer text contrast.

defects.problem: Unredacted screen shows 4111 1111 1111 1111, CVC 123 and a phone number immediately after the redaction beat. These are synthetic but clearly labelled only in a small footer.
defects.fix: Keep the 'Synthetic billing screen' footer at higher contrast during this beat.

couldNotAssess: Motion smoothness of dissolves and the headline entrances
Whether the screenshot or cursor moves between frames beyond what the sheet shows
oneLineVerdict: Stable, honest and tidy layout with no zoom or pans, but the opening dissolve smears text, the highlight beat is tiny, and the long end hold is a plain template with loose spacing.
